pretreatment: Annealing in vacuum at 700 K to remove H2O adlayer
surface_functionalization: H/D exchange achieved by D2O exposure at 700 K
evidence: The surface of the BN particles was characterized by transmission FTIR spectroscopy. After loading the sample in the vacuum chamber, an H2O adlayer was observed on the BN particles at 300 K. Annealing the sample in vacuum was required to remove this H2O adlayer. The surface functionality of the annealed BN particles was characterized by H/D exchange achieved by D2O exposure at 700 K.
